en: Prime Minister of India Narendra modi is cracking down on the recent Gen Z cockroach party protests.
zh: 印度總理莫迪正在鎮壓最近由 Z世代「蟑螂黨」發起的抗議活動。

en: We are witnessing a massive crackdown on student activists across the country.
zh: 我們正在目睹全國範圍內對學生維權人士的大規模鎮壓。據報道，自抗議活動正式取消以來，

notes.zh: run across someone：偶然遇見某人
notes.example: I ran across an old friend at the bookstore.

en: Police and states governed by Modi's BJP have reportedly arrested over 100 students in the days
zh: 警方和莫迪領導的印度人民黨執政的各邦已逮捕了 100 多名學生

en: since the protest was officially called off.
An online movement with one of the most unusual names in politics, the Cockroach Junta party took to the streets of New Delhi
zh: 一個名為「蟑螂軍政府」的線上運動，其名稱在政界堪稱最不尋常之一，他們走上新德里街頭進行

en: in protest, and helped force India's education minister, a man who is one of Modi's top advisors, to resign.
zh: 抗議，並迫使印度教育部長（莫迪的高級顧問之一）辭職。

en: It was a big win for the social media fueled youth movement, but it may come at a cost.
zh: 這對社群媒體推動的青年運動來說是一場重大勝利，但也可能付出代價。

notes.example: How come you didn't text me back?

en: Prime Minister Modi was one of the first Indian politicians to make social media central to his political strategy.
zh: 莫迪總理是最早將社群媒體作為政治戰略核心的印度政治家之一。

en: Modi was so politically savvy.
zh: 莫迪的政治手腕真是高明。

en: He understood the intrinsic power of these tools well before everybody else.
zh: 他比任何人都更早地認識到這些工具的內在力量。

notes.zh: Can I get you anything else?：餐廳服務生標準詢問句
notes.example: Can I get you anything else, like water?

en: Now, in the wake of the Cockroach Party protests, India's government is censoring social media,
zh: 現在，在蟑螂黨抗議活動之後，印度政府正在審查社群媒體，

notes.example: Try not to wake her up—she had a long flight.

en: removing posts related to the Cockroach Janta Party and their success.
zh: 刪除與蟑螂人民黨及其成功相關的貼文。

en: Social media has been the only avenue that that people have had to voice
zh: 社群媒體一直是人們表達對政府的

en: their discontent, disagreement and criticism of the government.
zh: 不滿、異議和批評的唯一方法。

en: The same internet that fueled Prime Minister Modi's rise to power
zh: 正是網路助力莫迪總理崛起，如今卻

en: is increasingly being used to control a movement challenging his government.
zh: 越來越多地被用來控制一場挑戰其政府的運動。

notes.zh: keep control over...：掌控某人或某事
notes.example: Staying calm helps you keep control over the conversation.

en: In 2014, Narendra modi was elected to be the Prime Minister of India,
zh: 2014年，莫迪當選為印度總理，他的競選綱領

en: having campaigned on a platform of economic growth and anti-corruption.
zh: 是經濟成長和反貪腐。

en: He was able to get this message out using what was then a cutting edge tool: the internet.
zh: 他利用當時最先進的工具—— 網路——將這訊息傳遞了出去。

en: In 2014, it was doing simple things like creating mass registries of people,
zh: 網路——將這訊息傳遞了出去。 2014 年，它還做一些簡單的事情，例如創建大量人員登記冊、

en: cell phone numbers, and communicating with them via SMS.
zh: 手機號碼登記冊，並透過簡訊與他們溝通。

en: These are things that are kind of commonplace in America, but in 2014, they were they were quite new.
zh: 這些事情在美國已經司空見慣，但在 2014 年，它們還是相當新穎的。

en: And then in the 2019 election, he doubled down on this strategy.
zh: 然後在2019年的選舉中，他加倍推行了這個策略。

en: He said that the election of 2019 is going to be fought on mobile phone.
zh: 他說，2019年的選舉將在手機上進行。

en: Today, Prime Minister Modi has the largest social media following of any world leader currently in office.
zh: 如今，莫迪總理是所有在任世界領導人中社群媒體粉絲最多的。

en: So of course, nowadays, if you if you look at any political party in India, they will be using a variety of social media tools,
zh: 所以，如今如果你看看印度的任何政黨，他們都會使用各種社群媒體工具，

en: but they've all been kind of playing catch up to where Modi was.
zh: 但他們都一直在努力追趕莫迪的步伐。

en: Now in 2026, there's growing disillusionment with the promises that Prime Minister Modi made.
zh: 如今到了2026年，人們對莫迪總理的承諾越來越失望。

notes.zh: you made it!：你成功辦到了／準時趕上了！
notes.example: I'm so glad you made it before the rain started.

en: And it all came to a head after a leaked exam.
zh: 這一切最終在一次考題外洩後爆發。

en: In India, every person who aspires to go to college or to finish high school even needs to pass a centrally administered exam.
zh: 在印度，每個想上大學或完成高中學業的人都需要通過中央統一組織的考試。

en: What happened in this particular case was the exam paper was leaked in advance,
zh: 在這個特殊案例中，考題提前洩露，

en: which forced the authorities to call off the exam, to postpone it, reschedule it for a different time.
zh: 迫使相關部門取消考試、延後考試或改期舉行。由於洩題或其他考試系統故障，

en: India has seen dozens of national and state exams canceled, annulled,
zh: 印度已有數十場國家級和州級考試被取消、作廢

en: or reconducted because of leaks or other breakdowns in the testing system.
zh: 或重新舉行。

en: This latest example led to widespread outrage and even suicides.
zh: 最近的這起事件引發了廣泛的憤怒，甚至導致了自殺事件。目前，

en: This is happening in a time where nearly 40% of graduates between 15 and 25 years old in India are unemployed,
zh: 印度 15 至 25 歲之間的畢業生中，近 40% 處於失業狀態，因此

en: making these exams crucial to any chance of securing a stable future.
zh: 這些考試對於他們能否獲得穩定的未來至關重要。

en: I think a lot of young Indians have been kind of led to believe this gospel of meritocracy,
zh: 我認為很多印度年輕人都被灌輸了一種精英主義的理念，認為

en: that if they work hard and they study hard, and they do well on these exams,
zh: 只要他們努力工作、努力學習，並在考試中取得好成績，就能考上

en: they'll get a place at a college. And that will allow them to get a well-paying job, and become sort of part of this kind of,
zh: 大學。這樣一來，他們就能找到一份高薪工作，並躋身於那種有

en: you know, aspirational middle class or upper middle class.
zh: 抱負的中產階級或中上階層。

en: The fact that these exams don't work the way they should, the fact that they're not enough jobs being created,
zh: 這些考試沒有發揮應有的作用，創造的就業機會不足，

en: the fact that even if you're lucky enough to get a job, it may not pay what you think you're worth.
zh: 即使你幸運地找到了一份工作，薪水也可能達不到你認為自己應得的水平。

en: There have been this kind of gathering sense of frustration amongst kind of India's Gen Z.
zh: 印度Z世代中逐漸滋生一種挫敗感。

en: There are youngsters like cockroaches.
zh: 有些年輕人就像蟑螂一樣。

en: They don't get any employment.
zh: 他們找不到工作。

en: They don't have any place in profession.
zh: 他們在專業領域沒有任何立足之地。

en: This comment from India's Chief Justice in May of 2026 landed poorly with India's already frustrated youth.
zh: 印度首席大法官在 2026 年 5 月發表的這番言論，激怒了印度本已感到沮喪的年輕人。

en: It became the catalyst that launched the satirical social media account
zh: 它成為了「蟑螂人民黨」 諷刺性社群媒體帳號的開通催化劑

en: for the Cockroach Janta Party or the Cockroach People's Party.
And it went viral. The Instagram account for the Cockroach Janta Party gained over 26 million followers.
zh: 然後它就火遍全網了。蟑螂人民黨的Instagram帳號獲得了超過2600萬粉絲。

en: That's a quarter of the number of Instagram followers Prime Minister Modi has
zh: 這相當於印度總理莫迪在 Instagram 上粉絲數量的四分之一。

en: Tech and social media and politics has been a mainstay of Indian campaigning elections for at least a dozen years.
zh: 科技、社群媒體和政治在過去至少十二年中一直是印度競選活動的主要組成部分。

en: But we haven't really seen this kind of very,
zh: 但我們還沒有真正看到這種非常

en: you know, young, slick, AI infected kind of viral memes
zh: 年輕、流暢、受人工智慧影響的病毒式迷因在大眾政治中

en: play such a central role in kind of mass politics.
zh: 發揮如此核心的作用。

en: So this was, I think, an inflection point.
zh: 所以，我認為這是一個轉捩點。你

en: And, you know, it was it was a kind of poignant one, because here you have
zh: 知道，這其實挺令人感慨的，因為

en: a ruling party, a government, which has had such a large technological advantage over the opposition, over its opponents,
zh: 執政黨、政府在技術上比反對派、對手擁有巨大的優勢，卻被

en: being kind of outsmarted, outplayed by a leaderless, brand new group of kind of dilettantes who are protesting
zh: 一群沒有領導、初出茅廬的新興團體——他們雖然在抗議，

en: but who are very conversant in the current technology.
zh: 但卻非常精通當前的技術——耍得團團轉。

en: This kind of played out like a David versus Goliath story.
zh: 這件事的發展就像大衛戰勝歌利亞的故事一樣。

en: Despite attempts by Modi's government to shut down internet and cell phone service to curb the protests, the Cockroach Janta Party
zh: 儘管莫迪政府試圖透過關閉網路和手機服務來遏制抗議活動，但「 蟑螂人民黨」還是

en: succeeded in forcing one of Modi's closest ministers to resign.
zh: 成功迫使莫迪最親近的部長之一辭職。

en: But this rare concession appears to have prompted a broader crackdown.
zh: 但這罕見的讓步似乎引發了更大範圍的打擊行動。

en: It's the latest move from a government that has become increasingly restrictive of free speech.
zh: 這是政府日益限制言論自由的最新舉措。

en: Over the last five years, the Indian government has built what I call the infrastructure for censorship.
zh: 言論自由的最新舉措。在過去五年裡，印度政府建立了我稱為審查制度的基礎設施。

en: And they've created a criminal liability for social media platforms in that an employee of, let's say, a company like Facebook
zh: 他們也為社群媒體平台設立了刑事責任，例如，像 Facebook 或 Twitter 這樣的公司的員工，

en: or Twitter can be sent to jail if they don't comply with orders from the Indian government.
zh: 如果不遵守印度政府的命令，可能會被送進監獄。

en: Following the protests, Delhi Police filed charges over social media posts
zh: 抗議活動發生後，德里警方對社交媒體上一些被

en: they deemed derogatory, malicious and defamatory, demanding the platforms
zh: 他們認定為貶損、惡意和誹謗性的帖子提起訴訟，要求平台

en: take them down, as well as providing the information of the users.
zh: 刪除這些帖子，並提供用戶資訊。

en: And police used AI powered facial recognition software to identify protesters.
zh: 警方利用人工智慧臉部辨識軟體來辨識抗議者。

en: Some of the protesters are still in jail.
zh: 部分抗議者仍被關押。

en: Freedom of speech, is suffering. Hi friends.
zh: 言論自由正遭受衝擊。大家好。

en: Prime Minister Modi has made it clear that he is not accepting this movement's criticisms of his government.
zh: 莫迪總理已明確表示，他不接受該運動對其政府的批評。

notes.zh: you made it!：你成功辦到了／準時趕上了！
notes.example: I'm so glad you made it before the rain started.

en: In a recent Instagram video, he told the CJP that abuse solves nothing and that he forgives the misguided protesters.
zh: 在最近的一段 Instagram 影片中，他告訴 CJP，濫用權力解決不了任何問題，他原諒了那些誤入歧途的抗議者。

en: I think the legacy of the Cockroach Janta Party protests is going to be that
zh: 我認為「蟑螂人民黨」抗議活動的影響將是

en: it's going lead to the the strengthening of censorship laws in India.
zh: 促使印度加強審查制度。

en: And this isn't exactly new in Indian politics.
zh: 這在印度政壇並非什麼新鮮事。在印度，

en: Every government tries to censor social media in India.
zh: 每一屆政府都試圖審查社群媒體。在印度，

en: Every government tries to suppress criticism and and the media in India.
zh: 每個政府都試圖壓制批評聲音和媒體。

en: The question is, how much further will Modi's government go to censor its people and restrict free speech?
zh: 問題是，莫迪政府還會走多遠，才會對民眾進行審查，限制言論自由？

en: And they're going to try and evolve mechanisms to try and ensure that this never happens again.
zh: 他們將努力完善相關機制，以確保此類事件不再發生。

notes.zh: better late than never：亡羊補牢猶未晚也
notes.example: I finally started exercising—better late than never!

en: The real success of the Cockroach Junta party may be how it pushed new issues to the forefront of Indian politics.
zh: 蟑螂黨真正的成功之處或許在於它將一些新議題推到了印度政治的前沿。

en: I think one of the puzzles for people who've studied Indian politics for a long time is why haven't basic human rights,
zh: 我認為，長期研究印度政治的人一直困惑的一個問題是，為什麼

en: like health and education kind of been on the political agenda?
zh: 像健康和教育這樣的基本人權沒有被納入政治議程？

en: And, you know, I think one legacy is that these protests have really made those issues mass issues.
zh: 而且，我認為其中一個影響是，這些抗議活動真正使這些問題成為了群眾性問題。

notes.zh: you made it!：你成功辦到了／準時趕上了！
notes.example: I'm so glad you made it before the rain started.

en: I feel like the older generations are kind of accepted.
zh: 我覺得老一輩挺被社會接納的。這就是

en: The fact that this is just how the country works and learn to live with it.
zh: 這個國家的運作方式，你必須學會接受。

en: But I like the fact that kids are not willing to stick with that.
zh: 但我喜歡孩子不願意墨守成規這一點。

en: They could start to drive party platforms, what politicians talk about, what voters demand.
zh: 他們可以開始左右政黨綱領、政治人物的言論以及選民的需求。我認為

en: And I think, you know, if that were to happen, that would be just a massive sea change.
zh: 選民的需求。我認為，如果這種情況真的發生，那將是一場巨大的變革。

en: Thanks so much for watching.
zh: 非常感謝您的觀看。
